summary: PROMPTS 8 & 9 validated end-to-end. Added 24 new pytest cases (TestAdminDashboardMetrics/Finance/Margin, TestSettingsWrites, TestNotificationPrefs, TestNotifications) to /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py. Total suite: 58/58 pass (serial -n 0) after cleaning stale non-seed test data. All 5 new admin dashboard endpoints work with strict RBAC (ADMIN full; OPERATOR 200 on /metrics + /todo, 403 on /finance + /margin; CLIENT 403 on all). Decimal math on margin verified (revenue - cost == margin per row, no float artefacts, amounts serialized as strings). Idempotent notifications verified via direct MongoDB read: package_received writes exactly 1 row per (event,PACKAGE,pid); non-essential events (package_received, quote_ready) become SKIPPED when notify_non_essential=false while essentials (payment_confirmed) always fire (status SENT or FAILED — @example.com addresses expected to yield FAILED from Resend but ROW IS RECORDED). ADMIN can create hub/carrier/zone; OPERATOR gets 403 on those writes (/delivery-zones POST, /carriers POST, /settings PUT). Frontend Playwright (1440x900): (1) ADMIN /admin renders admin-dashboard with metric-revenue + margin-section + todo-lists; margin date range apply loads margin-table. (2) OPERATOR /admin renders admin-dashboard but metric-revenue and margin-section are NOT in the DOM (defence-in-depth: UI hides + server 403). (3) ADMIN /admin/settings shows 5 tabs; creating a zone with UITEST_ prefix succeeds and appears in list. (4) CLIENT /client/profile shows notify-non-essential-switch; Space-key toggle triggers PUT 200, aria-checked flips, persists across reload (verified via response inspection).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is now 1284 lines — should be split (routers/dashboard.py, routers/reference.py, routers/me.py, routers/admin_ships.py, etc.).

notify_event key = (event, entity_type, entity_id). For SHIPMENT transitions the entity_id is composed as `${sid}:${to_status}` which is a good workaround for per-state uniqueness — consider documenting this pattern or using a dedicated `state` field to keep entity_id semantically the shipment id.

emailer.send_email raises RuntimeError('EMERGENT_EMAIL_KEY manquant') if the key is missing — notify_event catches this and records FAILED, which is correct. But if the key rotates and every email fails, there is no alerting/monitoring path — recommend a periodic health check on notifications.status == 'FAILED' rate.

notify_event does not put a unique index on {event, entity_type, entity_id}. Idempotency is enforced by find_one-before-insert which is a TOCTOU race under concurrency. Recommend: db.notifications.create_index([('event',1),('entity_type',1),('entity_id',1)], unique=True) so a duplicate insert becomes a DuplicateKeyError instead of a duplicate row.

admin_dashboard_margin does not paginate. With many shipments (>5000 hard cap in .to_list) the endpoint will silently truncate. Consider streaming aggregation via $lookup on payments + cost_records to move the join into MongoDB.

admin_dashboard_finance filters PAID payments in Python by paid_at >= month_start; this pulls the entire payments collection each call (to_list(5000)). Add a Mongo filter: find({'status':'PAID','paid_at':{'$gte': ms}}).

AdminSettings.jsx: CreateForm has no data-testid for delivery_mode select in a discoverable way for tests (works because the field's data-testid is derived, but confirm shadcn native <select> — it is a plain <select>, OK).

ClientProfile GET /me/profile currently returns `serialize(None)` (None) when the profile doc is missing, which would blank the form. Not an issue for seeded users but if a Google-provisioned user has no profile, the form fields will be empty. Recommend: create profile lazily on first /me/profile GET.

Before running suite: purge db.packages(merchant_name != 'Amazon FR'), db.shipments(reference != 'SHP-DEMO'), db.payments, db.notifications, db.status_history({entity_type:{$in:['SHIPMENT','PAYMENT']}}), db.shipment_packages. TestNotifications reads MONGO_URL + DB_NAME directly from /app/backend/.env via pymongo. Idempotency check on notifications collection: rows with status in (SENT, FAILED, SKIPPED) are all counted as 'recorded'. For @example.com destinations Resend will typically return FAILED — that's expected and does NOT break the tests. Payment.simulate uses POST /api/me/payments/{pid}/simulate {result:'success'} which routes through _process_payment → notify_event('payment_confirmed'). Admin ship transitions PREPARING→SHIPPED→ARRIVED_BENIN→DELIVERED each fire a notification with entity_id=`${sid}:${to_status}`.
